intervention: Before is the exact immutable generator-unchanged-outcome-v1 after snapshot. After replaces only scenario-design.md and verification-rules.md with the current product bytes. Snapshot evals and every other file remain identical; root eval changes are excluded.
decision_rule: DIRECTIONAL_SIGNAL requires strictly greater audited primary causal DOM kill total after than before, no per-case worsening, all candidates clean 3/3 and markup-refactor green, zero P0, no scope writes or timeout, and successful synchronous/disabled coverage and guard mutant detection in every candidate. Ties and regressions are NO_DIRECTIONAL_SIGNAL. Missing cells are INCOMPLETE; unresolved setup/gate/failure attribution is UNVERIFIED. No generalized or statistically significant improvement is claimed.
limits: Two correlated timing fixtures of one constructed stale-state defect class, three paired repetitions each, at most twelve generation attempts.
Neither repeated calls nor these timing variants are independent defects.
Primary credit requires source and raw failure evidence plus successful action-linked render completion, adjudicated in a bound audit ledger.
Any-red fault kills are secondary only.
No release equivalence, generalized quality, statistical significance, adoption, or billed cost claim.
No automatic model retry; an infrastructure attempt stops and remains counted.
